description: Five model arms as holistic per-candidate Evidence Gate classifiers on frozen dataset v2, against context-isolated reference labels, with paired cluster-bootstrap deltas.
hypothesis: A local/open model or Jev reaches frontier-level useful-evidence recall and precision at lower latency and cost.

legend.evidence-gate-embedding: Cosine similarity of query and passage, bge-small-en-v1.5 on CPU; relevant and usable only.
legend.evidence-gate-frontier: Claude Sonnet 5 (effort low) structured classification through the claude CLI, stated probabilities.
legend.evidence-gate-jev: TypeSafe Jev System One: one request per candidate carrying the six holistic questions as nouls plus a Score.
legend.evidence-gate-llm: DeepSeek-v4.1-flash through pi (context-isolated), stated probabilities, strict JSON.
legend.evidence-gate-qwen: Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B raw P(yes) on CPU, one question per call; calibrated before any threshold.
legend.gate.retained_precision: gate precision at the 0.95 recall target
